newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SOCCER-PROHASKA CASTS AUSTRIA AS UNDERDOGS IN WORLD CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PROHASKA CASTS AUSTRIA AS UNDERDOGS IN WORLD CUP.

text.p: Austrian coach Herbert Prohaska cast his men in the role of underdogs when he named his squad for their World Cup qualifer against Sweden on October 9.
"We will have to deliver an exceptionally good performance if we want to win," he said. "However, our chances of qualifying are not completely over if we lose on Wednesday."

Prohaska nominated eight foreign-based players for the game in Stockholm including Arnold Wetl, who will be making his first appearance for the side since joining Portugal's FC Porto at the start of the season.
"Wetl is a good player to have on the left side. He can play both in the defence and attack" Prohaska said about the former Sturm Graz midfielder.

Werder Bremen's Andreas Herzog, SV Hamburg's Markus Schopp and striker Anton Polster of 1FC Cologne, will be missing from the team's first training session on Saturday because they are due to play in the German Bundesliga.
Sweden have won both their opening matches, against Belarus and Latvia, while Austria drew 0-0 against Scotland in their only qualifier to date.
Goalkeepers - Michael Konsel (Rapid Vienna), Franz Wohlfahrt (VfB Stuttgart, Germany)

Defenders - Wolfgang Feiersinger (Borussia Dortmund, Germany), Michael Hatz (Reggiana, Italy), Anton Pfeffer (Austria Vienna), Walter Kogler (SV Salzburg), Peter Schoettel (Rapid Vienna), Andreas Heraf (Rapid Vienna)

Midfielders - Dietmar Kuehbauer (Rapid Vienna) Christian Prosenik (Rapid Vienna), Peter Stoeger (Rapid Vienna) Andreas Herzog (Werder Bremen, Germany) Arnold Wetl (FC Porto, Portugal), Stefan Marasek (SC Freiburg, Germany), Markus Schopp (Hamburger SV, Germany)
Attackers - Toni Polster (1FC Cologne, Germany), Dieter Ramusch (Casino Graz), Herfried Sabitzer (Casino Graz)
